name: Drilling, grouting and seabed preparation
description: Drill through difficult ground (drive-drill-drive), grout pile-to-sleeve or monopile connections, prepare seabed and clear UXO before foundation installation. Primary source: https://acteon.com/solutions/project-lifecycle/offshore-construction/integrated-marine-foundation-installation-services/hydraulic-hammers

specifications.basis: Acteon brochure listing 'Drive-drill-drive (3D) method for monopiles'
specifications.value: combines pile driving and drilling to reach target depth in hard, rocky or variable ground
UXO detection and removal before scour protection; rock placement by fallpipe vessel Rockpiper; each piling operation ~24 hours including driving through pre-laid scour protection
UXO survey and removal; seabed preparation; 11 suction bucket jacket installations

applications: Drill through difficult ground (drive-drill-drive), grout pile-to-sleeve or monopile connections, prepare seabed and clear UXO before foundation installation.
